skills.name: ux-skill-foundations
skills.description: Build a brand's design system with ux-skill and bring it into Figma as variables and components that match the code. Use when the user wants Figma variables, modes or components from a brand color, a brief or an existing token file, or wants a Figma library checked against the tokens a site ships. Load figma-use alongside it for every use_figma call.
